decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel draws directly on the firm's core cryptography and authentication knowledge and fits its push toward binding mobile communication, so own R&D can keep improving it.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is the backbone of the integrated offering and the firm's deepest area of knowledge, so the firm can interpret its results and develop it further.

The email-to-app robot uses the firm's secure messaging competence, but its niche use case and weaker market signals after several unobserved years make rework or withdrawal a real possibility, though not yet the likelier outcome.

Ongoing payment regulation such as PSD2 strong customer authentication sustains demand that the firm's cryptography know-how can serve, although the compliance-specific suite may be folded into broader offerings.
